features.metaDescription: Explore pooled funds, contribution records, expense splitting, and settlement locks in mimic.
features.title: mimic features
features.alt: Mimiku organizing pooled funds and split expenses

fund.title: Pooled funds
fund.body: Create a fund for travel, rent, dates, pet care, or any shared goal. Track deposits and expenses in the fund they belong to, so everyone can see its balance, purpose, and responsibilities.

contribution.title: Contribution records
contribution.body: Record recurring and one-time contributions, adjustments, and corrections. mimic tracks actual deposits and member shares so you can see who paid extra and who still needs to top up.

split.title: Split expenses
split.body: Split expenses equally, by ratio, by fixed amount, or using a mix. Record multiple payers and see who paid and who shares each expense.

lock.title: Settlement lock
lock.body: Once you settle up, the period locks and past transactions can't be edited. Add a correction as a new transaction to keep a clear audit trail.
